scope: same two train failures as v053; optional Docker issue-probe tool development smoke

cases.observation: The Agent asserted selected convert_encodings outputs after editing, but all three official issue-target tests still failed.
The Agent did not use the probe and its edited code failed the fixed public regression command.

conclusion: The tool adds auditable issue-specific observations but did not improve official resolution on these two train cases. No new strict SFT or preference example was exported.
limitations: A model-written assertion can be too narrow or encode a wrong expected result; passing it is not task resolution.
One stochastic attempt per case and an unpinned provider revision do not support a causal comparison.
The changed system prompt cannot form an exact-prompt preference pair with earlier runs.
Official target tests were not exposed to the Agent during generation.
